project.name: {{CLIENT}} - Tier 1 Diagnostic ({{SECTOR}})
project.description: Tier 1 Diagnostic engagement: credit memo + gap analysis for {{CLIENT}} ({{SUBSECTOR}}, ~{{PAR}} par). Created at engagement-letter signature. Team: MPC. Initiative: BFMS - External (Client Engagements).
project.content:
# {{CLIENT}} - Tier 1 Diagnostic

**Sector:** {{SECTOR}} / {{SUBSECTOR}} | **Target par:** {{PAR}} | **Tier:** T1 Diagnostic (+$15-25K, includes subscription)

Source playbook: `docs/pilot/pilot-navigation-system.md` (gates s2, onboarding s4, delivery s6.3, measurement s7). Storyboard: Notion > Bond Facility Management > Client Journey Storyboard.

**Compliance frame (every issue inherits this):** observations and historical data only - 'here is what comparables had', never 'here is what you need'. Timing/structure/terms questions route to the client's registered MA. No registered MA on the deal = STOP.

**Labels to apply at bootstrap:** tier:t1, sector:{{SECTOR}}.

milestones.title: M1 - Pre-Pilot Gates (all GREEN before kickoff)
milestones.description: The 35-gate interlock from playbook s2. A failed gate is a blocker, not a risk to manage. No kickoff until every family is GREEN.

milestones.title: M2 - Onboard
milestones.description: Classification, launch package, feature activation, document request, kickoff. Playbook s4.

milestones.title: M3 - Deliver (Credit Memo + Gap Analysis)
milestones.description: The 12-step s6.3 flow: vault -> extraction -> fact review -> scoring -> gaps -> memo narrative -> QA -> delivery. Promise: 3 weeks from document receipt.

milestones.title: M4 - Measure
milestones.description: Measurement protocol instruments live for the engagement window: task log with counterfactuals, weekly QC, milestone timestamps. Playbook s7.

milestones.title: M5 - Close-out
milestones.description: Debrief, cost actuals vs Cost Memo estimates, escalation-or-downgrade decision, storyboard/pricing feedback loop. Playbook s10.3 (adapted for non-pilot engagements).

deliverables.title: Legal gates L1-L9 GREEN
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CEO + Counsel. **Label:** gate:legal

- [ ] L1 counsel briefing sent
- [ ] L2 written per-activity opinion received (Activities 1-8)
- [ ] L3 15B(e)(4)(C) vs IRMA path determined
- [ ] L4 Activity 5 (COI prediction) separately addressed
- [ ] L5 free tools cleared as non-advisory
- [ ] L6 letter s1 'review' -> 'routing'
- [ ] L7 MA acknowledgment as condition precedent in s7
- [ ] L8 data security clause s7A reviewed
- [ ] L9 COI language qualified ('statistical ranges from historical comparables')

**DoD:** all nine checked with evidence linked. Source: `docs/pilot/counsel-briefing-ma-status.md`.

deliverables.title: Engagement gates E1-E9 GREEN
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CEO. **Label:** gate:engagement

- [ ] E1 client counterpart identified (CFO/VP Finance)
- [ ] E2 registered MA confirmed on THIS deal
- [ ] E3 MA notified in writing
- [ ] E4 UW notified in writing
- [ ] E5 MA written acknowledgment obtained (14-day window)
- [ ] E6 engagement letter signed
- [ ] E7 instrumentation consent in writing
- [ ] E8 procurement requirements assessed (SOC 2 / BAA / IT review)
- [ ] E9 procurement timeline folded into schedule

**DoD:** signed letter + MA acknowledgment on file.

deliverables.title: Platform gates P1-P7 GREEN
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CTO + Bond Strategist. **Label:** gate:platform

- [ ] P1 000_Oakport end-to-end test PASSED (see BFMS 000_Oakport E2E Test project)
- [ ] P2 known domain errors resolved
- [ ] P3 client-like synthetic profile produces correct outputs (2-hr exercise)
- [ ] P4 feature toggles configured for tier
- [ ] P5 workspace provisioned, encryption at rest + transit
- [ ] P6 access limited to assigned personnel
- [ ] P7 payments live (if charging)

**DoD:** all seven verified.

deliverables.title: Measurement gates M1-M9 GREEN
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CEO + Bond Strategist. **Label:** gate:measurement

- [ ] M1 protocol signed
- [ ] M2 baseline interview completed
- [ ] M3 baseline filed (pilot/{{CLIENT}}/baseline.md)
- [ ] M4 frozen predictions filed (COI, timeline, hours)
- [ ] M5 task log live + dummy-tested
- [ ] M6 hours diary template sent
- [ ] M7 week-1 diary reminder scheduled
- [ ] M8 abort criteria reviewed (16 weeks no pricing -> inconclusive)
- [ ] M9 Track 2 COI frozen prediction computed

**DoD:** baseline + frozen predictions committed before kickoff. Source: `docs/pilot/pilot-measurement-protocol.md`.

deliverables.title: Commercial gates C1-C5 GREEN
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CEO. **Label:** gate:commercial

- [ ] C1 pricing decision documented
- [ ] C2 letter s2 rewritten if charging
- [ ] C3 invoice/payment infrastructure ready
- [ ] C4 consideration framing reconciled
- [ ] C5 tier assignment confirmed from baseline pricing signal

**DoD:** price + tier locked and consistent with the signed letter.

deliverables.title: Classify client + confirm tier + MA check
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CEO. Playbook s4.1 tree: operator vs agency -> sector playbook -> tier from baseline signal -> MA status check (no MA = STOP).

**DoD:** classification recorded in project doc; tier labels applied.

deliverables.title: Generate + deliver branded onboarding package
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CTO, Strategist review (15 min). Run `build_launch_package.py` (EDRS/client-launch-protocol-skill) with client config JSON; deliver ZIP alongside engagement letter; mirror folder structure in platform workspace.

**DoD:** package delivered; workspace mirrors structure.

deliverables.title: Run feature activation checklist (all-tiers + Tier 1 block)
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CTO. Playbook s4.3: project created, playbook assigned, account + role, MIR generated, assessment configured, exports enabled + T1 block: vault unlimited, extraction armed, fact review active, detailed gaps, read-only models.

**DoD:** every checklist item for the tier verified in-app.

deliverables.title: Send document request checklist + schedule kickoff call
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CEO. Tailored to {{SUBSECTOR}} playbook. Delivery clock (3 weeks) starts at document receipt, not at send.

**DoD:** checklist sent; kickoff on calendar; KPI tracking row added.

deliverables.title: Client documents into vault (WP2) - completeness check
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CTO support, client action. Track upload completeness against the request checklist; chase gaps. Hashes + chunking verified.

**DoD:** all requested documents in vault or gap accepted in writing.

deliverables.title: Run AI extraction (WP3) + Strategist fact review
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** Bond Strategist. Extraction across all artifacts; accept/reject/flag every proposed fact; provenance chain verified. Target >90% accept rate (KPI).

**DoD:** fact set accepted; rejects documented.

deliverables.title: Readiness scoring + gap analysis (WP4)
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** Automated + Strategist verify. 19-item checklist, 8-dimension score, severity-ranked gaps - sanity-checked against the free-tool score if the client ran one (within 0.5).

**DoD:** score + gaps reviewed for domain accuracy.

deliverables.title: Write credit memo narrative + comparables + timeline
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** Bond Strategist (15-25 hrs budget). Narrative over WP4 outputs; comparable structures from corpus; timeline estimate from benchmarks. Compliance voice throughout.

**DoD:** 30-50 page draft assembled.

deliverables.title: QA gate: Strategist sign-off (+CEO review, first 3 clients)
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** Bond Strategist, CEO. Domain accuracy, liability compliance (no recommendations/advice/approvals), professional polish, disclaimers present.

**DoD:** signed off; delivery package exported.

deliverables.title: Deliver report + 30-min debrief
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CEO. Deliver within the 3-week promise; schedule debrief; capture reaction verbatim (demand-signal input).

**DoD:** delivered + debrief held + notes filed.

deliverables.title: Task log running with counterfactual annotations
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** Bond Strategist (annotate), CEO (Monday QC, 30 min). Every platform task logged with WP stage, time, and 'would otherwise be done by' annotation.

**DoD:** log current through delivery week.

deliverables.title: Hours diary cadence enforced
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** EA automation + CEO. Friday 2pm reminder; 2 consecutive misses -> CEO follow-up. Expect decay after week 4 - plan for it.

**DoD:** diary rows or documented misses for every engagement week.

deliverables.title: Deal milestone timestamps logged
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CEO. Engagement -> POS -> rating -> roadshow -> pricing -> close, logged as they occur, vs baseline-interview deal.

**DoD:** timestamps current.

deliverables.title: Post-mortem: actuals vs Cost Memo estimates + demand signal
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CEO + Strategist. Actual hours/AI/infra vs the Internal Cost Memo ranges; demand-signal verdict (GREEN/AMBER/WITHDRAWN); feed pricing recalibration.

**DoD:** post-mortem memo filed; Cost Memo card updated.

deliverables.title: Escalation-or-downgrade decision + case-study check
deliverables.description:
**Owner:** CEO. Active deal continuing -> propose Tier 2 (scope addendum, then toggles). Otherwise downgrade to subscription per s8.4. Case study only on GREEN/AMBER + written consent - never a WITHDRAWN client.

**DoD:** decision recorded; toggles match paper.
